g.text: Inside ONE action-expert layer: the actual MHA8 computation
Repeat this layer structure 18 times per denoising step, and reuse the same learned weights for all 10 steps.
Reshape to [1,8,20,256]; apply RoPE to Q and K
Append cached prefix K/V for this layer
Gated residual: Y = X + gate1 * attention_output
Gated residual: Xnext = Y + gate2 * FFN_output
Time conditioning is cached, not removed from the model
2 adaptive norms per layer x 18 layers + 1 final norm = 37
Each dense 1024 -> 3072 produces scale, shift, gate (1024 each)
The online RMSNorm and residual/gating operations still execute
Softmax is applied over 988 key positions
Scale remains 1/sqrt(256)=1/16; head_dim did NOT change.
2 cached AdaRMS dense layers add 6.298M / 24.023 MiB.
What changes, and what does not?
Attention width returns to 2048; residual width stays 1024.
FFN width stays 4096. There is ONE prefix-conditioned attention
module per layer, not alternating self/cross-attention blocks.
After layer 18: final cached AdaRMS, then action_out 1024 -> 32.
Final adaptive norm's gate output is not used as an extra residual.
This pi0.5 path uses H=20 action tokens, not H+1. State is tokenized in the observation prefix. Shapes are physical, including prefix padding.
Displayed computation is the measured native OpenPI eager-attention path; QK, Softmax and SV are explicit. Matrix labels use input -> output, not stored [out,in].
